front.title: Considerations for Agent Gateway Integration within the DAWN Framework

abstract.t: This document specifies the integration architecture, discovery proxy mechanisms, and operational workflows for the Agent Gateway (AGW) within the Discovery of Agents With Names (DAWN) problem space. Addressing the core problem of how an agent discovers peer agents across administrative and network boundaries, this specification defines the dual role of the Agent Gateway: serving as an Outbound Discovery Proxy (Discovery Substrate Access Point) that assists local domain agents in querying external discovery fabrics, and an Inbound Domain Discovery Proxy (Broker/Aggregator) that enables external agents to discover matching capabilities situated on sub-agents behind the gateway. The document outlines the internal capability matching engine, selective disclosure mechanisms for privacy preservation, DNS-SD/mDNS resource record mappings, and strict boundary alignments with the IETF DAWN Working Group Charter.
